worldcombat.skill.spite.summary: Send a slow, homing grudge at a target: the hit remembers the target's most recent real offense and tears 4 PP out of the move that target used last. The next time the target lands an effective direct hit with that remembered offense, the hit is cut down to a fraction and the grudge is spent; switching moves or acting without damage bypasses it. With no readable recent offense only the PP is settled. The grudge itself deals no damage and fizzles if it cannot keep up, is shaken off or meets an obstacle.
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.0: Blunt the next blow from the move that just hurt you
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.1: Tear PP out of a move a foe relies on
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.2: Punish a target that keeps leaning on one move
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.0: The grudge reaches %1$s blocks and flies at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; it deals no damage itself - a hit only records the target's most recent offense and may leave a grudge.
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.1: On hitting a Pokemon it cuts %1$s PP from the move that target used last; only casts within the last %2$s count, and an older move, no usable move or an empty one simply loses nothing.
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.2: The next effective direct hit with the remembered offense keeps only %2$s of its damage, then the grudge is spent; switching moves or acting without damage bypasses it. The grudge lasts %1$s and expires or is cleared. Each tick the bolt turns at most %3$s degrees toward the target; if it cannot keep up, is shaken off or meets an obstacle it fizzles, recording nothing.
worldcombat.skill.spite.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spite.growth.0: From level %1$s the memory window rises to %2$s s and the grudge lasts %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spite.growth.1: From level %1$s the memory window is %2$s s and the range %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spite.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of casting. Larger values chase harder and are shaken off more often on the way.
worldcombat.skill.spite.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to send a grudge; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
